items.headline: Josh Hoover, Indiana get first win at Michigan since 1967
items.description: Josh Hoover had a 4-yard TD run in overtime and No. 6 Indiana kept Michigan out of the end zone in a 13-6 win -- the Hoosiers' first at the Big House since 1967.
